meaning_zh: adj.酷热的,炽热的,极其愤怒的,感情强烈的
v.猛烈地燃烧( blaze的现在分词 ),发光，照耀
example_en: I waited for her under the blazing sunlight, shielding my face with my school bag.
example_zh: 我在炽热的阳光下等她, 屏障遮挡着我的脸和我的书包.

example_en: So the world really can look bleach to somebody who's depressed.
example_zh: 对抑郁的人来说,世界在他们眼中看上去是了无生趣的.

meaning_zh: adj.漂白的，晒白的，颜色变浅的
v.使（颜色）变淡，变白，漂白( bleach的过去式和过去分词 )
example_en: She bleached the stains out ( of the cloth )
example_zh: 她漂去了 ( 布料上的 ) 污渍.

meaning_zh: n.<美>（运动场的）廉价座位，露天看台,漂白者，漂白剂，露天看台( bleacher的名词复数 )
example_en: It's cheaper and most of the real baseball fans sit in the bleachers.
example_zh: 露天看台便宜,而且大多数真正的棒球球迷都坐在露天看台.

meaning_zh: adj.暗淡的，无望的,阴冷的,凄清的,沮丧的
example_en: I glimpsed a bleak future.
example_zh: 我隐约感到前途黯淡.

meaning_zh: vi.（羊，小牛）叫,哭诉,发出羊叫似的声音,轻声诉说
vt.咩咩地发出,以颤抖可怜的声音说出,愚蠢地讲
example_en: The poor goat would bleat in pain until it died.
example_zh: 那只可怜的羊痛苦地哀叫着直到死去.

meaning_zh: v.流血( bleed的过去式和过去分词 ),勒索，敲诈,散开,给（某人）放血
example_en: He almost bled to death after the bullet severed an artery.
example_zh: 子弹穿过动脉，他失血过多几乎性命不保。

meaning_zh: v.流血（ bleed的现在分词 ）,勒索，敲诈,散开,给（某人）放血
adj.流血的,血腥的,该死的,讨厌的
example_en: No preoperative bleeding or airway swelling was noted in any patient.
example_zh: 没有任何患者在围手术期观察到出血或者呼吸道肿胀.

example_en: Please bleep the doctor on duty immediately.
example_zh: 请立刻用传呼机召值班医生.

meaning_zh: vt.有损…的完美,玷污,损害,弄脏
example_en: He was pilloried, but she escaped without blemish.
example_zh: 他受到公众的批评, 她却名声未损地得以逃脱.

example_en: Do you think these two colours will blend together?
example_zh: 你认为这两种颜色和谐 吗 ?

example_en: Cook spinach in water, strain and chop finely ( can use blender to make ), set aside.
example_zh: 把菠菜煮熟剁成蓉 ( 可用搅拌器打成蓉 ), 隔去水份, 待用.

meaning_zh: v.（使）混合( blend的现在分词 ),（使）混杂,（使）调和,协调
example_en: The city is a happy blending of town and country.
example_zh: 这个城市是城乡的巧妙结合.

example_en: Please God bless you and the suffering of the children!
example_zh: 请保佑赐福与你苦难的孩子们吧！

meaning_zh: adj.神圣的,有福的, 无忧无虑的
example_en: May you and your whole family be abundantly blessed this year!
example_zh: 愿你和你全家今年祝福满满!

meaning_zh: n.幸事，福祉,支持，批准,祈祷
example_en: Being the child a wealthy entrepreneur must be something of a mixed blessing.
example_zh: 身为富有企业家的孩子,肯定是件祸福参半的事情.

meaning_zh: n.凋萎病,坏因素,毁坏,衰退
vt.使凋萎,使颓丧,损害,妨害
example_en: Sudden loss of fortune came as a blight to his hopes of going abroad.
example_zh: 突然的财产损失摧残了他出国的希望.

meaning_zh: vt.（尤指用布）挡住（某人）的视线,蒙住（某人）的眼睛,使不理解,蒙骗
n.蒙眼的绷带[布等],障眼物，蒙蔽人的事物
example_en: Don't let his flattery blindfold you to his true intentions.
example_zh: 不要让他的阿谀蒙蔽了他的真正意图.

meaning_zh: adj.炫目的，耀眼的,使人眼花缭乱的,使人昏聩的,刺眼的
v.使失明，使眩晕(blind的现在分词)
example_en: One blinding flash after another came, and peal on peal of deafening thunder.
example_zh: 耀眼的闪电一道紧跟着一道, 震耳的雷声一阵尾随着一阵.

meaning_zh: n.一种戴着以显示财富的珠宝，也泛指昂贵而炫耀的拥有品
int.象声词，模拟眼前一亮的声音
example_en: Big-name jewellers are battling it out to get celebrities to wear their bling.
example_zh: 大牌珠宝商竞相邀约名人佩戴其名贵首饰。

meaning_zh: n.极乐,天赐的福,幸福无比,狂喜
example_en: For her, he was the kernel of life, and to touch him alone was bliss.
example_zh: 他是她生活的核心, 碰他一下就是一种莫大的幸福.

example_en: Was there a life after death? This was another question that cat was blissfully unaware of.
example_zh: 人死之后还会有生命 吗 ?这个问题猫咪也不会去想.这倒是它的福气.

example_en: A compression bandage placed over a blister can provide relief.
example_zh: 用紧缩绑带覆盖于脚泡上能够起到缓解的作用.

meaning_zh: n.闪电战,大规模空袭,突然袭击，闪电攻势
example_en: The blitz was the most common tactic of German fascists during WWII.
example_zh: “闪电战”是二战时德国的法西斯军队最常用的战术之一.

meaning_zh: n.闪电战，闪击战，（尤指）猛烈的空袭
example_en: And though he acted with what seemed at the time like blitzkrieg aggressiveness , he regretted in later years that he hadn't moved even faster.
example_zh: 虽然他的行动在当时看来就像一场闪电战, 但他后来却后悔自己没能更快.

example_en: Q : What will happen to the Blizzard brand name?
example_zh: 对暴雪的商标品牌名称有何影响?

meaning_zh: n.一滴,一抹,难以名状的一团
example_en: This system detects the blob above the base plane by locating the borders.
example_zh: 该系统采用基于基值平面的思想,定位分界线来检测色谱峰.

meaning_zh: n.（政治利益一致的）国家集团,共同体
example_en: The Bloc Quebecois's associate health critic was also unhappy with the decision.
example_zh: 魁北克人党的医疗卫生评论家也对此项决定感到不满.

meaning_zh: n.封锁,封锁部队,障碍物，阻碍物
example_en: The key tasks for 2001 also called for breaching regional blockade and departmental and trade monopoly.
example_zh: 2001年的整顿和规范市场经济秩序的重点任务中,还有打破地区封锁和部门、行业垄断尚未部署,将在适当时间安排.

meaning_zh: n.重磅炸弹，了不起的人或事,大片,风靡一时的事物
example_en: Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte and Miranda another bite out of sequel to the 2008 summer blockbuster.
example_zh: 凯莉 、 萨曼莎 、 夏洛特、米兰达四人继2008年夏天后再次向观众展示各自酸甜苦辣的纽约生活.

example_en: Note: We offer no guarantees on the quality and we advise to use a pop - up blocker !
example_zh: 注: 我们提供任何保证,对质量,我们奉劝使用 弹出窗口 阻止!

meaning_zh: n.博客,即开博客的人,derived from weblogger, s.o. who keeps a weblog
example_en: Imagine a blogger who uses a Creative Commons license.
example_zh: 设想有一博客写手使用了知识共享许可协议.

example_en: There was also criticism, coupled with about the official explanation, on the blogosphere.
example_zh: 还有来自博客圈的批评和对官方解释的怀疑.

example_en: A yellow blouse goes with her blonde hair.
example_zh: 黄色短上衣和她的金发很相称.

meaning_zh: n.流血,屠杀，杀戮,流血事件
example_en: There was heavy bloodshed in their first encounter at sea.
example_zh: 第一次海上冲突,他们双方都伤亡惨重.

example_en: His eyes turned bloodshot, and he was metamorphosed into a raging fiend ( Jack London )
example_zh: 他两眼血红,霎时变成了一个暴怒的魔鬼 ( 杰克伦敦 )

example_en: Conclusion Automated blood culture systems were important apparatus for diagnosis of bloodstream infection.
example_zh: 结论快速血培养技术是血液感染病原学诊断必要手段.

meaning_zh: adj.（加强语气）该死的,血腥的,血淋淋的
example_en: Nullah: Mrs. Boss! We gotta get those fat cheeky bulls into that big bloody metal ship!
example_zh: 纳拉: 老板夫人! 我们已经把这群肥胖的公牛赶紧那艘该死的大铁船里了.

example_en: So we mixed with some antic elements. For instance, the obese bloomers and the large collar.
example_zh: 所以其中融入了一些小丑的元素, 比如说肥大的灯笼裤,大领子.

meaning_zh: adj.盛开的,妙龄的,<俚>十足的、非常的,开坯
example_en: Fig. 1 . The average number of foragers per minute on a blooming plum during daytime.
example_zh: 图一开花李树上平均每天不同时间之访花昆虫数量.

meaning_zh: n.污渍,墨渍,弱点,（十五子棋中）易被吃掉的孤立棋子
vi.（污点或污渍）溅出,被吸掉
example_en: Methods Polymerase chain reaction ( PCR ) connected with reverse dot blot ( RDB ) were performed.
example_zh: 方法采用多聚酶链反应 ( PCR ) 结合反向斑点杂交 ( RDB ) 技术.

meaning_zh: n.（皮肤上的）红斑，疹块,大滴 [大片]（墨水或颜色的）污渍
example_en: His face was covered in ugly red blotch es.
example_zh: 他脸上有许多难看的红色大斑点.

meaning_zh: n.吸墨纸,临时记录簿，记事本
example_en: The ink was absorbed by the blotter.
example_zh: 墨水被吸墨纸吸干了.

example_en: Blow a kiss and ride away.
example_zh: 飞吻，然后骑车离开。

example_en: My hat blew off while I was crossing the street.
example_zh: 当我过街时，帽子吹掉了。

meaning_zh: n.<美，非正>吹牛大王，自吹自擂的人
example_en: I don't want to sit next to that old blowhard.
example_zh: 我不想坐在那个爱自吹自擂的老人旁边.

meaning_zh: n.爆胎,盛宴,盛大聚会,轻易的胜利
example_en: The tire's had a blowout.
example_zh: 轮胎放炮了.

meaning_zh: adj.蓝领工人的,工人阶级的,体力劳动者的
example_en: Simple and unaffected house decoration suits the taste of white and Blue collar workers.
example_zh: 简单、质朴的居室装潢适合工薪阶层的口味.

example_en: That's why some people put bluebird houses in their gardens.
example_zh: 这正是人们把它们的巢安置在花园里的原因.

example_en: J : He's also the host of a bluegrass radio show and is also a musician himself.
example_zh: 他还在电台主持 兰草 音乐节目,还是个音乐家,那他会不会演奏乐器?

example_en: Maiden, your simplicity, like the blueness of the lake, reveals your depth of truth.
example_zh: 少女呀, 你的纯朴, 如湖水之碧,表现出你的真理之深邃.

example_en: True blues like my grandfather won't tolerate any sort of state control.
example_zh: 像我祖父这类反对变革的人物不会容忍任何形式的国家控制.

meaning_zh: n.蓝牙（一种无线传输技术）
example_en: Weightless and stylish, the V 3 Bluetooth headset an accessory of beautiful purpose.
example_zh: 失重和时尚, v3蓝牙耳机,是从犯美丽的目的.

example_en: He is kind and friendly despite his rather bluff manner.
example_zh: 他为人厚道,待人亲切,虽然态度有点粗鲁.

example_en: Mist clung there among the bluish tree shapes, beyond range of the lamps.
example_zh: 在灯光照不到的那些苍茫的树身中间,暮霭凝聚着.

meaning_zh: v.犯愚蠢的错误,不慎陷入,跌跌撞撞
example_en: Tom make a blunder in front of his girlfriend.
example_zh: 汤姆在女友面前犯了错.

meaning_zh: adj.钝的，不锋利的,直率的,呆板的
example_en: Do not worry over being quite blunt and honest with them.
example_zh: 和他们在一起不用担心太过直率和坦诚.

example_en: To put it bluntly, you're fired!
example_zh: 直截了当地说吧, 你被解雇了!

meaning_zh: v.（使）变得模糊不清,（使）看不清楚
example_en: A blur of sunlight was crawling across his hair.
example_zh: 一道耀眼的阳光正抹过他的头发.
